proposedRoleDescriptions.color: Large terracotta and lilac panels work as section surfaces. Text and action contrast must be checked per surface rather than inherited indiscriminately.
proposedRoleDescriptions.typography: Keep the serif identity distinct from sans content and small navigation. This hybrid can use a Swiss grid without requiring exclusively sans identity.

limits.semanticRoles: Null roles are deliberate. Element measurements do not establish canonical site-wide roles or scales.
limits.visibility: Nonzero element geometry does not prove visibility through loaders or overlays. Computed family requests do not prove successful font loading.
limits.coverage: Selected desktop samples and a supplied reference image when available; no complete responsive, interaction or accessibility audit.
limits.sourceDifferences: The serif mark is visually prominent despite the source summary emphasizing sans-serif type. Treat this as a hybrid, not orthodox Swiss typography.
limits.ownership: Third-party reference, not an approved production pack.
